title: Getting Help
about: Who to tell, and where to go, whatever goes wrong online.

cards.situation: Something online is worrying you. It's never your fault.

image.alt: You sit on your bed with your phone, thinking: Who do I even tell? On the phone, the faint outline of a board of helper tiles.

cards.prompt: These people are here to help. **Tap each one.**

parts.job: A parent, carer, teacher or school counsellor. Start here for anything.
Someone could get hurt right now? Call 000.
Free, private and open any time, for ages 5 to 25. Call 1800 55 1800.
For anyone in Australia, any time. Call 13 11 14.
Money gone from your card? Call your bank straight away.
Your details were stolen? IDCARE (idcare.org) helps you make a plan, for free.
Report a scam at scamwatch.gov.au, to warn others.
Bullying the app won't remove, or a private picture shared or threatened? esafety.gov.au.

cards.explanation: Eight helpers, and you can always start with a trusted adult.

cards.prompt: A scam took money from your card. You call your bank. **What can it do?**

image.alt: The Your bank tile is lit, and you're calling. Beside it, your bank card and a payment: Fake shop, $30.
image.revealAlt: The bank card now shows a lock: Frozen. The payment reads: $30, checking.

cards.explanation: Calling fast lets the bank stop payments and check this one. The sooner you call, the better your chance of getting money back.

cards.title: Who can help
cards.body: You never have to handle it alone. Start with a **trusted adult**, then go to the helper made for the problem.

image.alt: The Who can help? board, each tile with what it's for. Trusted adult: anything. 000: danger now. Kids Helpline and Lifeline: need to talk. Your bank: money. IDCARE: stolen details. Scamwatch: scams. eSafety: bullying, pictures.

cards.prompt: Not ready to tell family about a worry? **Tap who you could talk to.**

image.alt: You look unsure, thinking: Not ready to tell family. Beside you, part of the Who can help? board: Trusted adult, Kids Helpline, Lifeline and 000.

options.text: No one, until it gets really bad
options.nudge: Look at the board: who could you talk to outside your family?
000 is for danger right now. Who on the board could you just talk to?

cards.explanation: Yes: Kids Helpline, Lifeline and school counsellors are there to talk, so you don't have to cope alone.
cards.showAnswer: Kids Helpline, Lifeline or a school counsellor: you don't need a big problem to ask for help.

cards.prompt: Four different problems, four helpers. **Match each problem to its helper.**
cards.explanation: Right: each problem has a helper made for it, and 000 is for danger right now.
cards.nudge: Start with the one you're surest of. What did each helper's tile say it's for?
cards.showAnswer: Bullying goes to eSafety, card trouble to your bank, stolen details to IDCARE, and danger to 000.

cards.prompt: A fake shop got your card number and a photo of your ID. **Tap who to contact.**

image.alt: A fake shoe shop. Arrows point to two problems: your card number, and a photo of your ID.
image.revealAlt: Both problems ticked: your bank froze the card, and IDCARE helps with the photo of your ID.

options.nudge: There are two problems here: money and stolen details. Who helps with each?

options.text: Wait to see if any money goes
options.nudge: There are two problems here: money and stolen details. Who helps with each?

cards.explanation: Yes: your bank can protect the card, and IDCARE helps with your ID.
cards.showAnswer: Your bank for the card, straight away, then IDCARE for your ID.

cards.title: Recap
cards.body:
You never have to handle it alone: tell a trusted adult, then the right helper. It's never your fault.

**Try this:** Save **Kids Helpline** (1800 55 1800) and **Lifeline** (13 11 14) in your phone, next to someone you trust.

**Next:** The course final: show everything you've learned.
